title: StopPreview
description:
⟨H2⟩ What stopping the runtime interrupts (ADR-0014 §3.2 item 2, §3.3): read-only,
complete, changes nothing. An emergency restart prints the same list.

environment_endpoints.description:
WSL bridges and container endpoints that become unavailable inside their
environment.

held_bindings.description:
Bindings with a live holder: the child keeps running, its endpoint is gone until
restart.

in_memory_keys.description: Working keys held only in memory: gone, re-issued within their terms after restart.

issuer_key_access.description:
The macOS note: the issuer may lose access to its CA key after an update of a build
without a Developer ID signature, and whether an offline backup is recorded.

open_operations.description:
Operations not yet terminal: they settle or are reported, and are recovered or
reported after restart.

owned_connections.description: Owned multiplexing masters and dedicated connections, and what happens to each.

remote.description:
The transport and runner state that stops (a served Iroh endpoint; a runner issues
nothing while down).

running.description: Whether a runtime is serving now (nothing is interrupted when none is).

IssuerKeyAccessNote.description: The macOS update note of a [`StopPreview`].

may_lose_access.description: Whether the issuer may lose access to its CA key after an update.

offline_backup_recorded.description: Whether an offline recovery bundle is recorded.

StopPreviewItem.description: One interrupted item of a [`StopPreview`]: its kind, its ID, and what happens to it.
